title: 5 source modules missing //! module-level doc comments
description: email.rs, mailbox.rs, identity.rs, thread.rs, snippet.rs have no //! module-level doc comments. keyword.rs, query.rs, submission.rs, and vacation.rs (via // comments) all have documentation explaining what the module provides. The inconsistency matters for cargo doc output: readers navigating from lib.rs to email.rs or mailbox.rs get no orientation. Also vacation.rs uses // file-level comments instead of //! which are not picked up by rustdoc.
